name: livekit
description: Build, test, and ship voice agents with LiveKit. Skills for the LiveKit Agents SDK (Python and Node.js) covering voice AI architecture, live debugging, turn-level tests, simulations, deployment, and reading session data from LiveKit Cloud.

interface.longDescription: Skills that teach your coding agent to build, test, and ship voice agents with LiveKit and the LiveKit Agents SDK for Python and Node.js. Your coding agent looks up current LiveKit docs before writing code, talks to your agent turn by turn to check a change, writes turn-level tests, runs simulations before a release, deploys to LiveKit Cloud, and reads transcripts, logs, and traces from real sessions to find and fix problems. The skills use the LiveKit CLI (lk).
defaultPrompt: Build a LiveKit voice agent that books appointments
Test my LiveKit agent as a confused first-time caller
Find what went wrong in my agent's recent sessions
